citations.desc: Attending veterinarian and adequate veterinary care (dealers and exhibitors).
citations.narrative:
Phoenix, a 5-year-old Fennec Fox, was moved to a temporary enclosure on Sunday April 5, 2026. On Monday April 6,
2026, Phoenix was seen limping on his left back leg. The veterinarian was notified on April 8, 2026, and went to see the
Phoenix the same day. Then the animal was taken to the veterinary hospital, and radiographs were taken. A femur
fracture was found, and the animal was given Meloxicam. Phoenix was referred to an emergency veterinary hospital for
surgery.
Surgery repair was done at the specialty veterinary hospital on April 9, 2026. Phoenix was discharged on April 10, 2026,
and movement restriction for at least 14 days was recommended. Phoenix has gone back to the emergency veterinary
hospital for follow-ups on April 17 and 24, May 23 and June 3. The clinical history shows that Phoenix wounds post-
surgery have improved. However, Phoenix is barely putting weight on the affected limb and muscles loss in the affected
area was noted.
Timely and accurate information on problems of animal health, behavior, and well-being must be conveyed to the
attending veterinarian is of outmost importance to treat and prevent diseases.
Corrected prior to inspection on June 9, 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representatives.
